articles.title: Ahmedabad to get 10 ‘Made in India’ Metro trains: Govt
articles.summary: Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel inaugurated India's first indigenously manufactured Metro Train at Titagarh Rail Systems near Kolkata. This significant milestone underscores India's growing self-reliance and 'Made in India' capabilities in infrastructure. It marks a crucial step towards modernizing urban transport with domestic technology, boosting national manufacturing, and contributing to economic progress and strategic independence.

articles.title: Lt Col posted in the Department of Defence Production arrested in bribery case
articles.summary: The CBI recently arrested Lt Col Deepak Kumar Sharma, an officer from the Department of Defence Production under the Ministry of Defence. He was apprehended for allegedly accepting a bribe of three lakh rupees. This incident underscores the ongoing battle against corruption within government sectors, particularly impacting the crucial defence establishment, and highlights the importance of integrity among service personnel.

articles.title: INS Sindhughosh decommissioned after 40 years of glorious service: Navy
articles.summary: INS Sindhughosh, the Indian Navy's lead Kilo-class submarine, has been decommissioned in a ceremony at the Naval Dockyard in Mumbai. This significant event marks the end of its 40 years of distinguished service to the nation. Its retirement signifies a generational shift, making way for newer, more advanced naval assets to enhance India's maritime defence capabilities.

articles.title: sanskrit-heritage added to PyPI
articles.summary: A Python wrapper has been developed for the Sanskrit Heritage Platform, originally by Prof. Gérard Huet. This package provides a crucial bridge to the Heritage Engine, enabling users to process Sanskrit texts directly within Python. This technological advancement simplifies computational linguistics tasks for Sanskrit, offering significant benefits for researchers and developers working with ancient Indian languages, fostering digital preservation and analysis.

articles.title: ‘A high risk’ – Barcelona star ruled out of Villarreal clash
articles.summary: La Liga giants Barcelona face a significant challenge as star midfielder Pedri has been confirmed unavailable for their crucial upcoming showdown against Villarreal. Manager Hansi Flick officially announced Pedri's absence, meaning the team will need to adapt their strategy without one of their key playmakers. This development could impact Barcelona's performance in the vital match, necessitating adjustments from the Catalan side.

articles.title: Russian Defence Ministry holds a briefing for military attachés of foreign states
articles.summary: General of the Army Valery Gerasimov, Chief of the General Staff of the Russian Armed Forces and First Deputy Defence Minister, held a briefing for military personnel on December 18, 2025. This significant event from a top Russian military leader likely covered strategic defence matters, providing crucial updates or directives within the armed forces. It highlights the ongoing operational and planning activities of Russia's defence establishment.
